mapper.select:

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LIB_BOOK ( BOOK_MNG_NO, BOOK_NM, BOOK_IMG_ATCH_FILE_ID, AUT_NM, PBLCO_NM, PBLCN_YR, CLNO, BOOK_PSTN_NM, BOOK_CN, RCMDTN_YN, RCMDTN_CLSF_CD, RCMDTN_SORT_SEQ, NEW_BOOK_YR, NEW_BOOK_MM, EXPSR_YN, REG_YMD, WRTR_NM, INQ_CNT, RGTR, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{bookMngNo}, #{bookNm}, #{bookImgAtchFileId}, #{autNm}, #{pblcoNm}, #{pblcnYr}, #{clno}, #{bookPstnNm}, #{bookCn}, #{rcmdtnYn}, #{rcmdtnClsfCd}, #{rcmdtnSortSeq}, #{newBookYr}, #{newBookMm}, #{expsrYn}, #{regYmd}, #{wrtrNm}, #{inqCnt}, #{rgtr}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE LIB_BOOK SET BOOK_MNG_NO = #{bookMngNo}, BOOK_NM = #{bookNm}, BOOK_IMG_ATCH_FILE_ID = #{bookImgAtchFileId}, AUT_NM = #{autNm}, PBLCO_NM = #{pblcoNm}, PBLCN_YR = #{pblcnYr}, CLNO = #{clno}, BOOK_PSTN_NM = #{bookPstnNm}, BOOK_CN = #{bookCn}, RCMDTN_YN = #{rcmdtnYn}, RCMDTN_CLSF_CD = #{rcmdtnClsfCd}, RCMDTN_SORT_SEQ = #{rcmdtnSortSeq}, NEW_BOOK_YR = #{newBookYr}, NEW_BOOK_MM = #{newBookMm}, EXPSR_YN = #{expsrYn}, REG_YMD = #{regYmd}, WRTR_NM = #{wrtrNm}, INQ_CNT = #{inqCnt}, MDTR = #{mdtr}, MDFCN_DT = NOW() WHERE BOOK_SN = #{bookSn} AND DEL_DT IS NULL
UPDATE LIB_BOOK SET DEL_DT = NOW(), DELTR = 'admin' WHERE BOOK_SN = #{bookSn} AND DEL_DT IS NULL
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM LIB_BOOK_REL R INNER JOIN LIB_BOOK B ON B.BOOK_SN = R.REL_BOOK_SN LEFT JOIN CMMN_CD_DTL C ON C.CD_ID = 'COM046' AND C.CD_DTL_ID = B.RCMDTN_CLSF_CD WHERE R.BOOK_SN = #{bookSn} AND B.DEL_DT IS NULL ORDER BY R.SORT_SEQ ASC, B.REG_YMD DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LIB_BOOK_REL ( BOOK_SN, REL_BOOK_SN, SORT_SEQ, RGTR, REG_DT ) VALUES ( #{bookSn}, #{relBookSn}, #{sortSeq}, #{rgtr}, NOW() )
mapper.select:
SELECT
WHERE B.DEL_DT IS NULL
AND B.BOOK_SN != #{excludeBookSn}
AND B.BOOK_MNG_NO LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND B.BOOK_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND B.AUT_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND B.PBLCO_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND B.CLNO LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%')
AND ( B.BOOK_MNG_NO LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR B.BOOK_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR B.AUT_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR B.PBLCO_NM LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') OR B.CLNO LIKE CONCAT('%', #{searchKeyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY B.REG_YMD DESC, B.BOOK_SN DESC LIMIT #{limit}
